description:
Change a project's name, description, published state or colony, as
    its owner or a collaborator, or who may edit its files (``edit_policy``),
    as its owner or a site admin. The people ``edit_policy`` lets in edit
    files only: they may not change any of these. A change of colony puts
    ``edit_policy`` back to collaborators; given with the new colony, it
    applies to that one. The slug cannot change.

colony.description: A colony's name to move it there, or an empty string to take it out of its colony. Omit to keep it.
colony.title: Colony

description.description: A new description; an empty string clears it.
description.title: Description

edit_policy.description: Who may edit its files besides its owner and collaborators: collaborators (nobody more), members, moderators or colony_wiki (whoever its colony's wiki policy lets edit the wiki) of its colony. The owner's and a site admin's to set (FORBIDDEN for a collaborator); any value but collaborators needs the project in a colony (INVALID_INPUT). Omit to keep it.
edit_policy.title: Edit Policy

is_published.description: true publishes it, false takes it back to a draft.
is_published.title: Is Published

name.description: A new name; omit to keep it.
name.title: Name

name: colony_update_project
